scope_determinations.applicability: Applies to commercial data handling, licensee reporting, and statutory regulatory oversight.
scope_determinations.interpretations: Hohfeldian classification strictly enforced: privileges, duties, claims, immunities, and powers.
scope_determinations.exceptions: Explicit warrant or statutory mandate overrides commercial privacy duty only when validly attested.
scope_determinations.priorities: Public oversight statutory mandate supersedes general commercial privacy default liberties.

claim_limit: Operational sampling budget across 30 representative cases; not a statistical accuracy guarantee.
